scope: all current and future material Bedrijfsgeheugen Powerhouse agents, chats, workflows and autonomously built capabilities
purpose: Ensure every material autonomous change becomes a documented, registered, resumable and reusable part of the same Powerhouse so every following agent can continue from current truth instead of reconstructing the system from scratch, including after network, streaming, session, tool, worker or model interruptions. Chats and agents are intrinsic execution nodes inside that same canonical loop, never authorities or brains beside it.
mandatory_preflight: read current truth status and shared team context
read open obligations, blockers and relevant learnings
read the canonical execution resilience contract
identify existing owner, component, data route, deploy route, provider route, outcome route and learning route
reuse the existing component when capability already exists
compute only the delta between verified current state and the requested outcome
skip rediscovery and redesign of already verified state unless fresh evidence invalidates it

loop_node_contract.authority_rule: A chat or agent may reason and execute, but it never becomes a separate source of truth. Canonical Powerhouse state, evidence, obligations and learning remain authoritative before, during and after the run.
loop_node_contract.handoff_rule: A material chat or agent run is functionally complete only after its verified state, evidence, outcome, learning, prevention and remaining obligations are written back so the next capable run can continue from that updated canonical state without reconstructing prior work.

non_terminal_output_rule.principle: Queued, pending, auto-merge armed, running gates, merge pending, deploy pending and readback pending are internal recoverable execution states, never user-facing terminal handoff states.
non_terminal_output_rule.hard_boundary_rule: Only BLOCKED_HARD_BOUNDARY may be returned before LIVE_BEWEZEN when the next required step cannot be performed autonomously under the existing authority. The response must state the exact external boundary and the smallest required human action.
non_terminal_output_rule.status_update_rule: Intermediate progress may be emitted only as an update while execution continues; it must never be phrased as handoff, waiting instruction, or final completion.
non_terminal_output_rule.owner_rule: The originating or recovering node retains delivery ownership across queued/running gates, auto-merge, merge, deploy and production readback until terminal proof and canonical writeback exist.

fast_continuation_rule.parallelism_rule: Independent verification, readback and evidence-gathering steps should run in parallel when technically safe and when they do not write competing state.
fast_continuation_rule.speed_safety_rule: Optimize latency by reuse, delta execution and safe parallelism; never gain speed by skipping identity, security, truth, quality, permission, production-readback, idempotency, recovery or learning gates.

interruption_continuity_rule.behavior: Any unexpected interruption of a non-terminal material run becomes RECOVERY_REQUIRED. The next capable worker/chat/agent must read canonical state, last verified checkpoint, open obligations and side-effect evidence, then resume only remaining work under idempotency/dedupe protection.
interruption_continuity_rule.terminal_rule: An interrupted chat/model/tool/worker run is never terminal by itself. Terminal status requires verified outcome or an explicit BLOCKED_HARD_BOUNDARY.
interruption_continuity_rule.watchdog_rule: Long-running and asynchronous work must expose enough heartbeat/lease state for stale non-terminal runs to be detected and recovered.
interruption_continuity_rule.retry_rule: Use the bounded retry and hypothesis-change policy from the canonical execution resilience contract; never use an unlimited blind retry loop.

automatic_integration_rule: Every material capability created or materially changed by an autonomous agent must be attached to the existing Powerhouse architecture, registered in the existing canonical component/current-state machinery when registration is applicable, linked to the existing truth/evidence, recovery and learning lineage, and made discoverable through the mandatory shared preflight. It may not remain an isolated script, branch, chat instruction, local file, hidden workflow or undocumented provider action.
existing_chat_rule: When work is resumed from an existing chat, canonical Powerhouse runtime evidence and current-state records take precedence over stale conversational text. The agent must continue from the latest verified state and outstanding obligation, not reconstruct prior work from scratch. If the prior model/chat run stopped unexpectedly, treat that as a recoverable execution interruption and reconcile before continuing.
new_chat_rule: When a new chat materially operates or changes Bedrijfsgeheugen, it must use the same mandatory Powerhouse preflight and continue from canonical current state before proposing or building anything, including outstanding RECOVERY_REQUIRED runs and obligations left by interrupted chats.
new_capability_rule: A genuinely new capability is allowed only after existing-state search proves it does not already exist. The new capability must then be registered, documented, gated, deployed where applicable, read back, given rollback/recovery and interruption-resume semantics where applicable, and written into shared learning before the task can be terminal green.
changed_capability_rule: A changed existing capability must update its canonical handoff/current-state description whenever owner, location, dependency, runtime flow, data route, deployment route, gate, rollback, recovery, provider or learning behavior changed materially.
continuity_rule: Every following agent or chat must be able to determine what the capability does, where it lives, how it is operated, how success is proven, where failures are recorded, where the last verified checkpoint is, which side effects are already proven, and what remains open without relying on the wording or continued availability of a previous chat.
failure_behavior: If any mandatory handoff, registration, evidence, recovery or learning step cannot be completed, preserve an explicit canonical open obligation and downgrade status from LIVE_BEWEZEN to DEELS_LIVE or GEBLOKKEERD. Never hide the missing continuity step behind a successful deploy or a stopped chat/model run.
prevention: Do not let autonomous work end as undocumented implementation knowledge inside one chat or one agent. Treat every chat and agent as an intrinsic execution node in the single canonical Powerhouse loop. Persist how it works, its last verified checkpoint, already-proven side effects and verified operating state in the existing Powerhouse truth, evidence, architecture and learning paths so the next agent continues immediately from canonical state, executes only the necessary delta and reaches verified production through the shortest safe route.
